reqBaseAnnouncement.remarks: The Securities of the company will be transferred out from the Watch List to Main Board with effect from 2nd October 2026 as the company resolved the matters giving rise to the Emphasis of Matter on Going Concern in the Independent Auditor’s Reports on the Audited Financial Statements for the years ended 31st March 2024 and 31st March 2025 in terms of Rule 7.5 (d)(II) (14) of the CSE Listing Rules.
reqBaseAnnouncement.title: WATCH LIST - TRANSFERRED OUT
